qualifications: Conversion completed and metadata reports all source tensors released; this does not establish better model quality, serving speed, or a new default.
CPU build work overlapped the conversion. The original release executable had testability enabled. Wall time is a diagnostic observation, not a quiet conversion-speed benchmark.
MLX allocator peak, process maximum RSS, and peak process footprint have different accounting and measurement scopes; none is a substitute for the others.
The original log records passing template identity preflight. Its actual checked tensor scope is defined by the pinned rescorer source, not a claim that every full checkpoint byte was compared.

Only small conversion report, original log, and original build provenance are copied. Config/index/report hashes and sizes are captured here; model weight bytes are neither read for hashing nor copied.
The safetensors index reports tensor payload total_size, not a cryptographic checksum or exact on-disk checkpoint size.
Build provenance identifies selected artifacts and sources; it is not an immutable reconstruction of the complete dirty worktree.
